## sw-single-seek
-hide_banner -ss 60.000 -readrate 1.5 -readrate_initial_burst 60 -i /media/film.mkv -map 0:v:0 -vf bwdif=mode=send_frame:deint=interlaced,scale=1920:-2,setsar=1 -c:v libx264 -threads 8 -profile:v high -level:v 4.2 -x264opts subme=0:me_range=16:rc_lookahead=10:me=hex:open_gop=0 -crf 20 -maxrate 8000k -bufsize 16000k -preset veryfast -pix_fmt yuv420p -force_key_frames expr:gte(t,n_forced*3) -map 0:a:0 -c:a libfdk_aac -ac 2 -ar 48000 -b:a 192k -filter:a:0 aresample=out_chlayout=stereo:rematrix_maxval=1.4142,alimiter=limit=0.7943:attack=5:release=50:level=0:latency=1 -f hls -hls_time 3 -hls_list_size 0 -hls_playlist_type event -hls_flags temp_file -start_number 20 -hls_segment_type fmp4 -hls_fmp4_init_filename stream_0_init.mp4 -hls_segment_filename /cache/h/stream_0_%03d.m4s /cache/h/stream_0.m3u8

## sw-single-telecine
-hide_banner -i /media/film.mkv -map 0:v:0 -vf fieldmatch=order=auto:combmatch=full,bwdif=mode=send_frame:deint=interlaced,decimate,scale=1920:-2,setsar=1 -c:v libx264 -threads 8 -profile:v high -level:v 4.2 -x264opts subme=0:me_range=16:rc_lookahead=10:me=hex:open_gop=0 -crf 20 -maxrate 8000k -bufsize 16000k -preset veryfast -pix_fmt yuv420p -force_key_frames expr:gte(t,n_forced*3) -map 0:a:0 -c:a libfdk_aac -ac 2 -ar 48000 -b:a 192k -filter:a:0 aresample=out_chlayout=stereo:rematrix_maxval=1.4142,alimiter=limit=0.7943:attack=5:release=50:level=0:latency=1 -f hls -hls_time 3 -hls_list_size 0 -hls_playlist_type event -hls_flags temp_file -start_number 0 -hls_segment_type fmp4 -hls_fmp4_init_filename stream_0_init.mp4 -hls_segment_filename /cache/h/stream_0_%03d.m4s /cache/h/stream_0.m3u8

## sw-single-tonemap
-hide_banner -i /media/film.mkv -filter_complex [0:v]bwdif=mode=send_frame:deint=interlaced,setparams=color_primaries=bt2020:color_trc=smpte2084:colorspace=bt2020nc,scale=1920:-2,tonemapx=tonemap=bt2390:desat=0:peak=100:t=bt709:m=bt709:p=bt709:format=yuv420p,setsar=1[out] -map [out] -c:v libx264 -threads 8 -profile:v high -level:v 4.2 -x264opts subme=0:me_range=16:rc_lookahead=10:me=hex:open_gop=0 -crf 20 -maxrate 8000k -bufsize 16000k -preset veryfast -pix_fmt yuv420p -force_key_frames expr:gte(t,n_forced*3) -map 0:a:0 -c:a libfdk_aac -ac 2 -ar 48000 -b:a 192k -filter:a:0 aresample=out_chlayout=stereo:rematrix_maxval=1.4142,alimiter=limit=0.7943:attack=5:release=50:level=0:latency=1 -f hls -hls_time 3 -hls_list_size 0 -hls_playlist_type event -hls_flags temp_file -start_number 0 -hls_segment_type fmp4 -hls_fmp4_init_filename stream_0_init.mp4 -hls_segment_filename /cache/h/stream_0_%03d.m4s /cache/h/stream_0.m3u8
